name: collet
description: Holds a session inside the task it was given: one open task with the files it may touch and the command that ends it, a guard that refuses writes outside that list, and checks that each ship with a violation and a near miss so none of them counts as coverage before it has been shown to work. On a project that already plans its work in a roadmap, it writes no ledger of its own and enforces the files that plan declares.
